sloka: प्राप्तव्या वदि ते सीता हन्तव्याश्च निशाचराः।रघुनन्दन वक्ष्यामि श्रूयतां मे हितं वचः ।। ६.८५.१० ।।
transliteration: prāptavyā vadi te sītā hantavyāśca niśācarāḥ।raghunandana vakṣyāmi śrūyatāṁ me hitaṁ vacaḥ ।। 6.85.10 ।।

translations.english: "Delight of Raghus! You may listen to my words of advice. Let Saumithri march ahead to Nikumbhilam accompanied by the great army. On reaching, let Lakshmana who is capable of killing Indrajith discharge venomous serpents like deadly poisonous arrows from his bow in circular form and kill Rakshasas."
translations.hindi: दिण, वर्ती अग्नि की शिखा थी जो सोने के समान दमक रही थी । अग्निदेव ने स्वयं उपस्थित हो, हाव ग्रहण किआ था
